history.subject: 7 Nov 1885, 9:22 a.m., Craigellachie BC: Donald Smith drove the last spike of the Canadian Pacific Railway (Wikipedia, Canadian Encyclopedia, Ingenium). First spike bent, replaced, second attempt succeeded (TCE; Ingenium 'two swings'). Conventional iron spike, identical to the others (Wikipedia; Ingenium); a silver spike was prepared but the Governor General left with it (Wikipedia/TCE). Line ~4 800 km (Ingenium). Contract gave 10 years, built in about 5 (Wikipedia). Van Horne: 'All I can say is that the work has been done well in every way' (TCE). Smith kept the bent spike, strips cut from it were given to the wives of some of the party (Wikipedia; TCE: pins). 141 years = not round -> TBG only.

facts.subject: Baku Metro part 2. Construction stopped 1953, official reason lack of funds (urbanrail, mirprometro); National Library (eres.preslib.az): Khrushchev considered the metro 'a very expensive luxury' and froze it; in 1960, during his Baku visit for the 40th anniversary of Soviet power in Azerbaijan, the republic's leadership convinced him to restart (preslib); re-launched 1960 (urbanrail); first line re-routed for new urban developments (urbanrail, mirprometro). Opened 6 Nov 1967 with 5 stations, 5th in the USSR (Wikipedia, mirprometro). 1953->1960 = 7 years stopped, 1960->1967 = 7 years to finish (own arithmetic). Today 27 stations, 3 lines (Wikipedia citing metro.gov.az; urbanrail 27). Not used: first-section length conflict, 2026 section closure.

facts.subject: Sun: core ~15 million °C (NASA MSFC solarscience). Energy made in the core random-walks out: mean step ~0.09 cm (Mitalas & Sills 1992 via ScienceBlog; ScienceAlert '<0.1 cm'); core to surface ~170 000 years (Mitalas & Sills 1992 via ScienceAlert + ScienceBlog; OpenStax range 100 000 - 1 million years; NASA MSFC ~1 million years to the interface layer) -> we say 'bir hesablamaya görə təxminən 170 000 il' and give the range in the caption. Surface to Earth ~499 s = 8 min 19 s (ScienceBlog; PBS 'almost 500 seconds'). Straight line would be ~2.3 s (ScienceAlert). Different from 27 Oct Sun fact (mass loss).

facts.subject: Lake Baikal, Siberia: more than 330 rivers and streams flow in (Britannica; Wikipedia 'as many as 330'); the only outflow is the Angara (both). Deepest lake: Britannica 1 620 m, Wikipedia 1 642 m -> '1 600 metrdən çox'. Age 20-25 million years (Britannica) / 25-30 (Wikipedia) -> '20 milyon ildən çox'. About one-fifth of the fresh water on Earth's surface (Britannica; Wikipedia 22-23% / 19% unfrozen). Baikal seal (nerpa) endemic (Wikipedia; Britannica 'the one mammal species').

facts.subject: Sheki Khans' Palace (18th century: 1762 or 1797 per sources -> we say '18-ci əsr'). Shebeke windows made of small wooden parts without glue or nails (Wikipedia Shabaka; AZERTAC). 'More than 14,000 pieces are assembled, using neither nails nor glue' (Euronews 2017); master Tofig Rasulov: 'six months to build one square metre' (Euronews). Inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List 7 July 2019 as 'Historic Centre of Sheki with the Khan's Palace' (Wikipedia, UNESCO ref 1549).
